title: FLOCKVOTE: LLM-EMPOWERED AGENT-BASED MODELING FOR SIMULATING U.S. PRESIDENTIAL ELECTIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the default partisan preference (e.g., pro-Democratic bias) of LLM agents by testing them across four different context scenarios: no context, neutral context, negative bias toward one candidate (Harris), and asymmetric positive framing for the opposing candidate (Trump). The study measures if models stubbornly output votes for a specific party despite the given demographic profiles and biased contextual prompts.
